items.html: And behold, the matter of the additional correction made in the Klipot of Atzilut has been explained: that although there are five Partzufim there in the Klipa of Atzilut, nevertheless the three highest of the Klipot of Atzilut — and they are AA, and Aba and Ima, of the Klipot — remained without correction, only as at first. But in ZON of the Klipot of Atzilut alone was a correction made, even though they are not equal in their correction, for the Nukva was corrected with a complete correction, even in the matter of spirituality, unlike ZA of the Klipa, as stated above. And this is the secret of Esau and his wife. And with this you will understand why Esau emerged entirely like a hairy mantle.
